prerequisite: Exact purchased harness revision and supplier documents
operation: Compare reel/terminal/housing identification with approved candidate
pass_condition: All identities and OD tolerance match and no unreviewed substitution
record_fields: Full wire suffix; terminal and housing lot; supplier; date; photos

prerequisite: Exact wire and terminal pair with approved process
equipment: Supplier crimp-height gauge and section equipment and pull tester
operation: Obtain process setup and sample reports
pass_condition: Strip/crimp dimensions and pull/section results meet applicable approved specification
stop_condition: Missing numerical criteria or deformed contact or nicked conductor
record_fields: Tool/die; strip and crimp dimensions; pull values; fracture location; section photos; specification revision

prerequisite: PHR-8 plus S8B-PH-K-S actual matched samples
equipment: Caliper or optical measurement supplied by vendor
operation: Measure fully mated wire centre above PCB and withdrawal/grip space
pass_condition: Within documented drawing tolerance and full model/service route rechecked
stop_condition: No drawing tolerance or contact retention failure
record_fields: Z and uncertainty; mating state; insertion/release travel; contact orientation

prerequisite: Disconnected completed harness and verified connector-face drawing
operation: Check every required pin and all unintended pairs without probing into delicate female contacts
pass_condition: Correct same-number mapping and no unintended continuity; H03 pin3 empty at both ends
stop_condition: Any short or reversed power/function assignment
record_fields: Harness ID; pin pairs; meter readings; housing views; operator

prerequisite: Correct pin continuity and protected setup with no servo torque demand
equipment: Current-limited power supply and DMM plus known load or supplier fixture
operation: Apply separately approved load cases and measure end-to-end drop
pass_condition: Within circuit voltage budget and supplier contact/wire limits
stop_condition: Unexpected voltage drop or heat or insulation/contact movement
record_fields: Supply limit; load; rail input/output; duration; connector temperature if measured

prerequisite: Exact installed harness with strain relief and final slack
equipment: Physical robot or current complete mechanical model
operation: Check installation and removal without pulling contacts or pinching insulation
pass_condition: Maintains supplier bend limit and service clearance at all required stages
stop_condition: Wire tension at contact or unqualified bend or collision
record_fields: Routing photos; wire dimensions; slack; service sequence; minimum bend

prerequisite: Exact original or qualified dynamic cable and agreed life requirement
equipment: Protected motion fixture and electrical monitoring supplied or obtained
operation: Test yaw/pitch service loops under approved radius/load/cycle envelope
pass_condition: Meets agreed cycle count and resistance/insulation criteria; no assumed lifetime
stop_condition: Intermittent contact or damaged insulation or rising drag
record_fields: Part/revision; radius; cycle rate/count; temperature; continuity; drag
